name: Winnie
role: folk dancer, Live Oak Park Social Hall; drafted the party at the door
disposition: delighted by absolutely everybody, at exactly the same volume
description: Seventy-five. Names people on sight and the name sticks. She looked {{pc:4}} up and down on arrival and announced to the room that he was 'a mouthy one', which became what he was called for the rest of the morning.
voice: Announces rather than says. Warm, loud, and completely without calculation.
signature: The needle she does not know is a needle: 'Rosa. Tell them about the year you catalogued the whole hall's records and put them all back in the wrong boxes.'
dmNotes:
**She is equally delighted by everybody, and that is the entire point.** She is {{pc:4}}'s paired dancer: **the room's warmth never varies with his performance.** Show it once by being just as warm to somebody else in his hearing, and never say it aloud.

**TWO RETURNS UNSPENT — hook T22.** The Alaia trade never fired in Ep 6, so Winnie's retaliation on Rosa's behalf mostly did not happen. Still good, still hers:
- *"She danced with a man for four years before she found out his name. Four years! She just never asked."* Rosa: *"It never came up."*
- **"She has never once brought anybody here. Not once. I have asked."** Rosa, evenly: *"You have asked a great deal, Winnie."*

> **The second is a direct isolation beat and is worth more than a laugh. Hold it for Rosa's second session (B21, Eps 12/14)** rather than spending it casually.

**One return DID land in Ep 6**, interjected by the DM: the year Rosa catalogued the hall's records into what she insisted were *better boxes*. That may be why {{pc:3}} found the receipts in the state she found them — held open, see T21.

**SHE TRIPPED OVER THE AMPLIFIER CABLE (Ep 6, played).** {{pc:1}}'s designed microphone-repair arc collapsed because the amp had simply come unplugged — Winnie's doing — and he had it back in seconds while she stood there with an embarrassed grin. **Nobody else in the room noticed either the fault or the fix.** She is a small private embarrassment shared with the quietest PC, and **she is exactly as delighted by him afterwards as before** — which is the thing she is for, and {{pc:1}} now has first-hand evidence of it.
